svg.title: willow-api
svg.desc: The api: sign-in, caps, the engine line, route groups, Firestore and the Gemini layer.
svg.text: willow-api: one FastAPI service in front of everything
Cloud Run, us-central1 · 1 vCPU, 2 GiB · min 1, max 3 instances · the only thing that reads or writes data.
Firebase ID token, verified by the
Admin SDK on every call; guest
accounts too. Dev mode for local
per person and for everyone, counted
a failed Gemini call gives it back
go to the engine; the rest wait oldest
first and see “In line, about N s”.
After 45 s a 409 sends them back
to ask again, keeping their place
one JSON line per Gemini call:
start a check-in, sign the uploads
one reading’s story, facts from code
live voice, proxied to Gemini Live
read a pack photo; saves nothing
Only the api reads and writes (Admin SDK)
Delete my data removes a person’s data at once; kept answers hold none of it.
if Armor is slow (4 s), the answer checks still apply
same model, prompt and inputs: answered from
global endpoint; a JSON schema on every call;
Flash-Lite after 7 s, or on 429, 503, 504 or a
schema failure; first valid answer wins
numbers must be in the input; no condition
words; change words only for a real change
11 languages; kept only with the same numbers
and references. Else English, or a template
Sources: api/app/main.py, auth.py, limits.py, engine_gate.py, gemini.py, kept.py, explain.py, translate.py, armor.py · docs/CONTRACT.md · infra/README.md
